<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7:1">Lev. R. s. 7</cite> <he>מן הד׳ קריא</he> from this verse (it is proven).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8:1">Lev. R. s. 8</cite> <he>ד׳ אמר לינא בעיא לד׳ וכ׳</he> the one said, I do not want this (woman) &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 112b:8">Sabb. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>לית ד׳ ב״א</he> this is not (an ordinary) human being; <cite ref="Shabbat 112b:8">ib.</cite> <he>כגון ד׳ וכ׳</he> a man like this is worth the name of a human being; a. fr.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ bot.; a. e. <he>אסיר לך דנא</he> this (piece) is forbidden to thee.—<he>מן קדמת דנא</he> ere this, formerly. Y. Sot. II, 17ᵈ; a. e.—<he>כְּדֵ׳</he>

<cite ref="Bava Batra 75a:9">B. Bath. 75ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="K00132"><he>כדכד</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 54:12">Is. LIV, 12</cite>) <he>ליהוי כד׳ וכד׳</he> let it be as this one says, and as that one; Pesik. Aniy. p. 135ᵇ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 32:1">Pesik. R. s. 32</cite>.—<he>בִּכְדֵין</he> in this manner.
Targ. I Kings XXII, 20.—מָדֵין = h. מַה־זֶּה, why.
Targ. Jer. XXVI, 9; a. e.—אֵי מִדֵּין from what, which.

Targ. Jon. I, 8.—דֵּינוּ (= דֵּין הוּ) this. Y. Erub. VII, 24ᶜ top, a. e. חֵי ד׳ צד וכ׳ (= h. אֵיזֶהוּ) which is ‘side’, and which &c.?, v. הַיְידְּנוּ.—Pl. דֵּינוּן, דֵּינֵי. Y. Snh. IV, 22ᵇ bot. הי ד׳ וכ׳ which are the two additional ones?—[הָדֵין then, v. הֵידֵין.]
